2.4.1 Straight type portable grinding machine - Grinding machine with the spindle of the line with the handle and the grinding action done by the periphery of the wheel.

6.7 Flange Plates -- Both the flange plates used to grip the abrasive wheel of grinding machine shall be of the same diameter and shall not be less than l/3 of the diameter of the abrasive wheel. 6.9 instruction ManualInstruction Manual shall be supplied with each grinding macl,ine. For details of data to be given in the instruction manual, reference may be made to IS : 11609 - 1986 `Technical supply conditions for pneumatic tools'. 7. Tests 7.1 Measurement of Air Consumption - Air consumption shall be determined with either The flow measuring instrument displacement meter or any suitable flow measuring instrument. be located within 3 metres from the grinding machine. 7.2 Measurement of Speed - For measurement of speed in revolution per minute ( rpm), any or non-contact type speed measuring device shall be used, such as tachometer or stroboscope. 7.3 Measurement of Pressure - For measurement of air pressure, gauge of any suitable used. The pressure to be read shall fall between one fourth and three fourth of full The pressure shall remain constant at 6'0 f 0'5 bars during testing. liquid shall
contact

type shall be scale reading.

7.4 No Load Test - No load running shall be carried out for a period of minimum 2 minutes. Speed and air consumption shall be measured during no load test. There shall be a tolerance of Ig percent of declared values of the speed and air consumption shall be within $5 percent of the declared values. 7.5 Load Test - Grinding machines of nominal size 100 and above will be subjected to load test. The load test shall be carried out by coupling the grinder-spindle to prony brake or to any suitable The speed and air consumption shall be measured at the specified attachment to cause resistance. load condition. Speed shall be within ?E percent of its declared values and the air consumption $5 percent of the declared values. shall be within

7.6 Operation Test - The grinding machine shall be tested for easy starting and stopping. The temperature rise on the surface of the machine shall not exceed 10�C above ambient, when tested, after running it for half an hour continuously on rated full load. 8. Marking - The grinding machines shall be maked at a suitable place so that in the course of normal use, the markings do not get damaged. The grinders shall be marked with manufacturer's name, initials or trade-mark, maximum working air pressure and maximum working speed. Grinding machines by the purchaser. 8.1 Certification
Marking

may also be marked with serial number and the year of manufacture
-

if desired

Details available

with the Bureau of Indian Standards.

9. Packing and Packaging - Before packing, the inlet, exhaust and other openings of each grinding machine shall be adequately protected/covered against entry of dust and other harmful material. Each grinding machine shall be packed in such a way that no damage is done during transit. For packing refer IS : 11609 - 1986. 10. Deckred Values - Manufacturers shall furnish the values of the following bars inlet air pressure, as their declared values, at the time of enquiry: parameters at 6 & 0'5 different

a) Wheel capacity of the grinding machine for different types of grinding wheels with bonds, b) No load speed, c) Air consumption on no load, d) Speed at the declared load condition for nominal sizes 100 and above, and e) Air consumption at the declared load condition for nominal sizes 100 and above. 4
